All 2401 x-values were examined in each relevant F_2401 census, yielding (10 roots,1391 nonzero squares,1000 nonsquares), hence 2794 curve points = the genus-four Hasse–Weil upper bound; its equality case forces Newton slopes 1/2. Counts for C_0 at extension degrees 1,2,3,4 and Newton–Weil identities prove (1+49T^4)^2; over F_49 both classes have (1+49T^2)^4. Verified in verify.py with VERIFY_OK.
